contract: Mouse hover on the mounted board previews the default rectangle/ellipse/triangle (120x80), Sticky (200x200), or Table (2x2, 120x48 cells) at the pointer in world coordinates. Pointer click creates that default; drag retains existing custom size/count behavior.

Preview uses the same appearance and geometry factories as actual creation, at 25% presentation opacity multiplied by object opacity. Pending IDs/styles/seed/axis identities are reserved once per prospective object in Runtime and reused on click; no canonical object, History or Operation is created by hover.

Attachment hover shows the same sibling and connector that the existing point-click factory will create, including source geometry dimensions, opposite port and current routing. Refactor/reuse that factory, preserving semantic endpoints and routing validation.

Hover is not an active editing session and does not block controls. Leave/blur/tool change/Down/drag/text editing/cancel/surface loss/stale basis retire ghost presentation. Guard full context and locks; never commit stale or extra ghost objects.

The ordinary SDK entry points remain unchanged. Existing private hover transport and native host input feed Runtime; Shell does not draw business geometry. Image export and snapshots exclude all ghosts.

matching Web mouse hover/leave/blur and native leave handling
